param.name: structures
param.label: Protein structures
param.help: Select PDB or mmCIF datasets, or a collection. Dataset names become sequence identifiers and must be unique after removing extensions and replacing special characters with underscores.

macros.token: ## Track normalized basenames independently of file type: same.pdb and same.cif ## would otherwise produce different symlinks but duplicate alignment identifiers. mkdir structures identifiers && #for $structure in $structures #set $identifier = re.sub(r'\.(pdb|cif)(\.gz)?$', '', str($structure.element_identifier)) #set $identifier = re.sub(r'[^\w.-]', '_', $identifier) if test -e 'identifiers/${identifier}'; then echo 'Duplicate structure identifier: ${identifier}. Rename input datasets to have unique identifiers.' >&2; exit 1; fi && touch 'identifiers/${identifier}' && ln -s '$structure' 'structures/${identifier}.${structure.file_ext}' && #end for

param.label: Minimum fraction of pairs with LDDT information
param.help: Exclude alignment columns with less structural information from scoring.
